data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 教室窗边的完美侧脸
data.description: 教室靠窗，她坐姿笔直地看书，白发在午后光里近乎透明；周围同学的窃窃私语全部被她无视，翻页的节奏都像设定好的程序——直到手机震动，她的视线瞬间离开书本。
data.action: 教室靠窗，她坐姿笔直地看书，白发在午后光里近乎透明
data.promptProse: Origami sits perfectly upright beside the classroom window, turning her book's page at an even pace until a vibration from the nearby phone draws her pale-blue eyes aside. Short white hair rests above her navy school collar. The medium seated view follows the wooden desktop toward empty classroom desks behind her. Afternoon window light outlines her bob and precise fingers, leaving the phone's small shadow beside the book.
